brief.topic: Rolling out an AI tool without changing the workflow around it
brief.audience: PMs and ops leads running internal AI rollouts

coreInsight: AI adoption stalls when the old process still has to be done in parallel; for each step the AI takes on, remove or merge an old one.

hooks.text: The AI tool launched. The old process stayed.
hooks.notes: Recognisable situation; sets up the redesign.

hooks.text: Your team is doing the work twice.
AI rollouts fail in the workflow, not the model.

selectionRationale: Highest total (22/25): a concrete before/after story, and the reel flips each surviving step into a redesigned one.

scenes.purpose: State the idea so it is clear from frame 0.
scenes.onScreen: The AI tool launched. The old process stayed. / So people did both.
scenes.voiceover: The AI tool launched. The old process stayed. So people did both.

storyboard.visual: Display headline with highlighted phrase; slate sub-line.
storyboard.animation: Readable on frame 0; underline sweep at 6; sub rises at 18.

scenes.purpose: Show the old steps that survive an AI rollout.
scenes.onScreen: WHAT STAYED / Same steps, plus AI. / STILL THERE Manual summary still required · STILL THERE Old approval form unchanged · STILL THERE Report built the old way
scenes.voiceover: What stayed: the manual summary is still required. The old approval form is unchanged. The report is built the old way.

scenes.onScreen: REDESIGN THE WORK / Remove a step for each AI step. / REPLACED AI draft is the record · MERGED Approve on the AI draft itself · REPLACED Report fed from AI output
scenes.voiceover: Redesign the work: the AI draft becomes the summary of record. Approval happens on the draft itself. The report is fed from AI output.

storyboard.visual: Same card stack (hard cut), new headline; each card flips to its counterpart.

swap.text: Approve on the AI draft itself

scenes.onScreen: If no step goes away, AI is extra work. / Share with whoever runs the rollout
scenes.voiceover: If no step goes away, AI is extra work. Share with whoever runs the rollout.

storyboard.visual: Takeaway lines, last highlighted; CTA pill; end card.
storyboard.animation: Lines rise; CTA at 40; end card at 70.

scenes.cta: Share with whoever runs the rollout

caption.opening: If the old process still has to be done, the AI tool isn’t saving time. It’s adding a step.
body:
Common leftovers:
→ A manual summary that’s still required
→ The old approval form, unchanged
→ Reports built the old way
For each step the AI takes on, remove or merge an old one: make the AI draft the record, approve on the draft, feed the report from it.

claims.text: AI tool adoption stalls when the previous process still has to be done in parallel; workflows should be redesigned so AI steps replace old ones.
